map_source: Ground-level 2D station layout plan supplied by the team (map.png).

map_scale.source: Scale bar printed on the plan: 0–50 m spans 281 px.

notes: Schematic layout, not surveyed and not to scale. Node and pathway positions were traced by hand from the team-supplied plan image (map.png); every node and pathway is pending on-site verification.
Accessibility of every pathway is unknown. Nothing here is a verified accessibility claim.
Distances are not measured; any distance shown is an estimate from the plan scale bar.
Pathways with verification 'simulated' (sug_*) were suggested by proximity where the plan shows no clear walkway.

Area polygons (platforms 7-12, track beds, main concourse, ticketing hall, building outline) are rectangles traced by hand from map.png; they are approximate. Extrusion heights are nominal display values (platforms 0.84 m, building 8 m), not measurements.

Visual cues are expected signage or plan features derived from the plan's labels and symbols (via node names) and from adjacent mapped nodes; none is verified on site (verified_on is null). The plan shows platforms 7-12 only and no foot-over-bridge, so no cues exist for other platforms or FOB stairs.

geo_reference.source: Station coordinate (13.0825 N, 80.2750 E, Wikipedia) pinned to the main concourse; plan treated as north-up per its compass; scale from the plan's scale bar.

panoramas_note: No Street View or photosphere pano ids are authored yet: none could be verified offline. Run `uv run python scripts/stations.py panoramas chennai_central --radius 150` with GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY set, check each pano on site or in Street View, and add it to station.json panoramas with verified_on.
